name: turn-end
description: The single blocking Stop hook. Plugins ship turn-end DUTIES instead of their own hooks; the runner checks each against real state and emits one consolidated message per user request. Replaces the mutually re-arming blocking hooks that fired eight times over one request. 0.9.0: TRACE SCHEMA v1 — the fire, every supply duty (engine / ms / cost / judge vs ranker picks) and a per-span acted-on derivation each leave their own line in the cross-plugin contract; hint-followed % is computable from disk.
